def execute(task, jobs, mode="all"):
    """Execute task on jobs filtered by mode.

    Jobs with a missing or None mode are treated as mode "all" and are
    included for every filter. Jobs whose mode is one of the known
    remote/hybrid/office modes are included only for the matching mode.
    Input order and input objects are preserved.
